content.short: The Santa Claus Club is a Cardano Based NFT Collection With Santas Year-Round Gift Giving Perks.
content.description:
Santa Claus has been working hard for hundreds of years to bring joy and happiness to boys and girls all over the world each year. On the 25th December, girls and boys of all ages wake up to wishes coming true that they could only dream about any other day.

The Santa Claus Club is Santa's way of going digital, in an ever-changing world of Tweets, Snapchats, and TikToks. Santa has employed his best and most trusted elf to distribute a unique and exclusive Cardano NFT artist impression of Santa in his favorite outfits to all the technologically advanced humans using the Cardano Blockchain.

This will be Santas window into the digital world of gift-giving, His Beta Test.

While Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Donner, Blitzen, and Rudolf speedily travel around the world with Santa Claus Himself, Santas elves will be digitally enabling Gift Giving using the Blockchain. Holding one of these pieces of Elf Created portraits of Santa will give you access to The Santa Claus Club and all the Joys and Gifts that come with it.
